newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico exchange extends money mart trading hours.
newsitem.headline: Mexico exchange extends money mart trading hours.

text.p: The Mexican Bolsa de Valores extended trading hours in the secondary money market, opening from eight in the morning to three in the afternoon, one hour extra at both ends, officials at the Bolsa, or exchange, said.
Both stocks and fixed income instruments trade at the Bolsa. The change took place on Friday.
"The hours will be from eight to three in the afternoon, on the demand of traders in the money market," said a spokesman for the Bolsa.
"The first hour of trading will be only to receive electronic bids," he said.
Much of the secondary money market trading takes place through electronic systems and only a small part through the trading floor at the Bolsa.
